title: Fix Buildkite release-plan runtime compatibility
intent: Make the Release / plan job reliably find the pinned cargo-dist binary in the Buildkite GitHub Actions runtime while preserving non-publishing PR plans and explicit-tag-only hosting.
proof_hooks: Buildkite Release / plan check passes on the corrective PR
deferred_questions: After Buildkite migration parity is verified for pull requests, master, releases, docs, and tags, decide when to disable the GitHub Actions service.
